description: This Java source file defines a Wear OS watch face service that displays the user's daily distance total via Google Fit. It manages GoogleApiClient connections, subscribes to distance data, and renders time and distance information dynamically on the watch face.

classes.name: FitDistanceWatchFaceService
classes.description: A service establishing a watch face that shows current time and daily distance from Google Fit.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine that handles drawing, Google Fit data retrieval, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the watch face, sets styles, creates paint objects, and sets up Google Fit API client.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles rendering the current time and daily distance on the Canvas, adjusting for ambient mode.

methods.name: getTotalDistance
methods.description: Requests the total distance data from Google Fit API.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient successfully connects; subscribes to distance data and fetches total distance.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the total distance query and updates the distance display.
